rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday term for emergency treatment aimed at saving someone who is unconscious or near death.

example.english: He collapsed, and the paramedics immediately performed resuscitation on him.
example.traditional: 佢暈低咗，救護員即刻幫佢急救。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wan4 dai1 zo2 gau3 wu6 jyun4 zik1 hak1 bong1 keoi5 gap1 gau3

rows.note: Use this specifically for cardiopulmonary resuscitation, especially when describing the procedure performed on someone whose heart or breathing has stopped.

example.english: After his heart stopped, the medical staff immediately performed resuscitation on him.
example.traditional: 佢心跳停咗之後，醫護人員即刻為佢施行心肺復甦術。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sam1 tiu3 ting4 zo2 zi1 hau6 ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 zik1 hak1 wai6 keoi5 si1 hang4 sam1 fai3 fuk6 sou1 seot6
